No more juggling multiple cords—just one reliable cable for all your essential devices

【Cruise Essentials 2026】Cut the cord clutter in your tiny cruise cabin. This all-in-one nylon braided cable charges both your iPhone and Apple Watch Series simultaneously. No overheating, no misalignment,magnetic watch charger locks on securely, even in rough seas. It's built for bumpy shore excursions, poolside luggage jumbles, and daily packing/unpacking. One cable, zero hassle—your 2026 cruise ship essentials

【High Quality Material】Featuring a sandblasted aluminum shell, unibody plug, and nylon braided wire, this multi charger cable lasts 30x longer than ordinary ones withstanding 45,000 bends. The magnetic iWatch charger uses premium aluminum alloy for enhanced heat dissipation and a secure magnetic alignment—no deformation or falling off, just efficient charging

【Fast Full Charging, Saving More Time】This type c to multi cable support fast charging up to 2A Max. Charges iPhone from 0% to 45% within 35 minutes, iWatch 50% within 45 minutes, don't support data transfer,please use 45W adapter when charge multi devices simultaneously
